summary: Grades college application essays with scores, line notes and a revision plan; the first essay is free, then Pro is 36 € and Unlimited is 54 € a month.
description: College Essay Grader (collegeessaygrader.ai) reviews Common App, UC, Coalition, UCAS and supplemental essays with a six-part score, margin notes and a revision plan. You can cancel anytime. A differently priced product exists at collegeessaygrader.com and is not this row.
